preview.text: China and Maldives play a T20 match at Bayuemas Oval, where China won the toss and chose to bat first. The usual first-innings score in the 85 recorded T20 matches at Bayuemas Oval is 118. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to an 88 per cent chance of rain and about 29 degrees.

summary.text: CHN scored 96-10 in their innings, with Zong Yuechao as their top scorer hitting 15 off 15 balls, while Azyan Farhath claimed the best bowling figures against them with 3 for 33. Maldives went on to win the match by 10 wkts. For context, the usual first-innings score in the 85 recorded T20 matches at Bayuemas Oval is 118.
